$$
\int 3 \cdot 2^{x} \left(2^{x} + 2\right)^{3}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "43505f39-47bc-5bcb-a52a-404c18fa49ce" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=2^{x} + 2$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(2^{x} \ln{\left(2 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

$$

$$
\frac{3}{\ln{\left(2 \right)}}\left(\int u^{3}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "43505f39-47bc-5bcb-a52a-404c18fa49ce" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "43505f39-47bc-5bcb-a52a-404c18fa49ce" :question/answer-fields
